After the first attempt failed due to resource exhaustion caused by incorrect logic, the agent claims it will implement a "corrected interpretation" of the rules. However, it generates code with the same logical flaws as the original, failing to recognize that its fix was not a fix at all.
errors.impact: The agent proceeds with a simulation based on an incorrect understanding of the game's mechanics. Although this second attempt completes without a timeout (due to a reduced number of simulations), the resulting data is invalid, leading to an unreliable final answer.
